text:
About 2.23% of the property was affected. Hansen/UMD mapped roughly 81.3 ha of tree-cover loss in 2021 within the 3,643.5 ha asset (ASSET-A). The JRC 2020 forest reference agrees on 98% of that area, and later years of the series were observed, so the loss is corroborated under the method.

Context: about 68.1 ha of the affected area is mapped as planted forest (pine), 13.2 ha lies outside mapped forest, and none is native forest. A further 37.3 ha of loss in patches under 0.5 ha is not counted in the 81.3 ha.

This shows tree-cover loss only. It does not establish deforestation or land-use change, since cutting a plantation counts as loss. It also says nothing about the cause, legality, who was responsible, or compliance.
